messages:
Ava: Thanks again for coming to the all-hands. Two quick asks from the reliability segment — please confirm RCA links, action owners, and whether any of the SLO tweaks on the roadmap need to be postponed. I pasted the RCA and the draft follow-up table here: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-07 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-reliability-followups

Tyler: I can take ownership of the autoscaler flaps RCA action (runbook update + test). ETA EOW.

Jana: I picked up the incident detection thresholds action — will validate sims and post results tomorrow morning.

Leo: Question on the SLO note from roadmap: are we actually changing the 99th percentile latency target or just the alert threshold? Need to know for dashboarding and runbook change.

Ava: Good call, Leo. Leadership asked for a conservative approach: do NOT change customer-facing SLOs right now, only adjust internal alert thresholds for week-of experiments. I'll update the roadmap doc and flag it.

Olivia: Quick visibility: I've added a column to the follow-up table for verification steps and test owners. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-reliability-followups (see spreadsheet 'post-allhands-actions') :memo:

Tyler: @Olivia thanks — I'll add the smoke test commands and expected metrics. Example snippet to include in the spreadsheet: 
```
# smoke test
ab -n 200 -c 10 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
# expect p99 < 350ms
```

Jana: FYI the alert adjustment experiment needs a canary window; proposing 48h in staging then 24h in prod with automated rollback if error rate delta > 0.2%. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Leo: Sounds reasonable. Can we add a monitoring dashboard tile for the delta and a pager rule tie to the canary?

Ava: Yes — add a dashboard tile and a temporary pager rule. Engineering leadership will review after the 72h combined canary.

sre-bot: INC-2026-07 RCA uploaded by @Tyler at 2167894400 — artifacts: logs, flamegraphs, heapdumps.

Tyler: Quick status update: runbook PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood/reliability/pull/482. Assigning @Ava for review and @Leo to add dashboard changes.

Olivia: Can owners please add expected verification dates in the spreadsheet by EOD today so we can export for the PM update?

Ava: Noted. Action items summary (copied here so it’s easy to grep):
- Tyler: runbook update + smoke tests (ETA EOW)
- Jana: threshold sims + verification (ETA next morning)
- Leo: dashboard tile + pager rule (ETA 48h)
- Olivia: verification steps column maintained and export for PM (ETA EOD)

Tyler: I'll post a short thread in #eng-sre with the smoke test commands and link to the PR for context.

Jana: If anyone wants to volunteer to sit with me during the staging canary on Thursday morning, ping me — want a second pair of eyes.

Ava: Thanks team. If there are any blockers escalate to me or drop in #release-war-room. Closing this thread once all ETAs land in the spreadsheet. :white_check_mark:
